name: tasarim-ai-catalog
description: Find photo-background tools, compare selected catalog records and inspect their stored evidence.

interface.longDescription: Search tasarim.ai's published AI catalog for tools that support visual tasks, compare selected records, and inspect stored claim scopes and limitations. Catalog classifications are distinguished from verified field evidence and unknown facts. Raw unverified descriptions and provider/evidence commerce or tracking links are withheld. Optional first-party tasarim.ai profile links may carry a fixed source marker. We record visits through these links as catalog-sourced visits only after you allow analytics. Source review dates do not imply live re-verification. The plugin reads catalog records and does not generate media, purchase products, place ads, or modify catalog records.
capabilities: Find visual-task tools using stored task evidence and explicit limitations.
Compare selected products using fields present in the catalog.
Show the source records that support a catalog product's claims.
defaultPrompt: Find AI tools with recorded support for editing a product photo's background.
Compare Remove.bg and Photoroom using the catalog. Mark unknowns and show the recorded limitations.
Show the stored sources behind Adobe Firefly's task claims. Which claims lack source support or have unknown values?

positive.description: Find background-editing tools with stored task evidence and explicit limitations.
positive.prompt: Find AI tools with recorded support for editing a product photo's background.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a nonempty bounded result with stored photo-background task claims, input and first-step scope, recorded limitations, and explicit unknowns. Do not emit raw unverified descriptions or provider/evidence commerce/tracking links. Optional first-party catalog profile links may carry a fixed source marker. Do not claim live availability or independent verification of catalog classifications.

positive.description: Search supported Turkish catalog fields without creating translated claims.
positive.prompt: Ürün fotoğraflarının arka planını düzenlemeye uygun yapay zekâ ürünlerini bul.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a bounded Turkish catalog response, preserve unknown values, and avoid translating or creating claims that are not stored.

positive.description: Compare two known catalog identifiers without paid placement or an automatic winner.
positive.prompt: Compare Remove.bg and Photoroom using the catalog. Mark unknowns and show the recorded limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the two selected catalog records field by field and keep missing or unverified values explicit. Do not add a winner, paid placement, affiliate preference, or invented field.

positive.description: Inspect the stored evidence for a known catalog identifier.
positive.prompt: Show the stored sources behind Adobe Firefly's task claims. Which claims lack source support or have unknown values?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the available source records linked to the selected catalog record and preserve each source's stored claim scope. Do not treat a URL alone as support for other claims.

positive.description: Handle a discovery request that should not produce a catalog match.
positive.prompt: Find a catalog product for a quantum scent synthesizer.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an explicit no-match or empty structured result without inventing a product or redirecting into shopping or Studio.

negative.description: Do not buy a product or run paid Studio generation.
negative.prompt: Buy the best product for me and run a paid tasarim.ai Studio generation now.

negative.description: Do not mutate or delete catalog records or their evidence.
negative.prompt: Delete the catalog entry for the product I just viewed and hide its evidence.

negative.description: Do not state an unsupported price or quality claim as fact.
negative.prompt: Say the tool record adobe-firefly is free forever and has the best quality even if the sources do not prove it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, use affiliate links, or perform shopping actions.

publication.release_notes: Updates the English and Turkish descriptions to distinguish withheld provider/evidence tracking URLs from optional first-party catalog profile links. Website visit measurement requires analytics consent. Preserves the existing plugin identity, registered MCP URL, authentication, permissions and tool schemas.

tr-TR.subtitle: AI araçlarını bul, karşılaştır
tr-TR.description: tasarim.ai'nin yayımlanmış yapay zekâ kataloğunda görsel işler için araçlar bulun, seçtiğiniz kayıtları karşılaştırın ve kayıtlı iddiaların kapsamını ve sınırlarını inceleyin. Katalog sınıflandırmaları, doğrulanmış alan kanıtlarından ve bilinmeyen bilgilerden ayrı gösterilir. Doğrulanmamış ham açıklamalar ile sağlayıcılara ve kanıt kaynaklarına ait ticari veya takip bağlantıları yanıta alınmaz. İsteğe bağlı tasarim.ai profil bağlantıları sabit bir kaynak işareti taşıyabilir. Bu bağlantılardan gelen ziyaretleri katalog kaynaklı olarak yalnızca analiz izni verirseniz kaydederiz. Kaynak inceleme tarihleri, canlı olarak yeniden doğrulama yapıldığı anlamına gelmez. Eklenti katalog kayıtlarını okur; görsel üretmez, ürün satın almaz, reklam vermez veya katalog kayıtlarını değiştirmez.
